name: Pierce Facade
source: Heroes of the High Court pg. 25
body:
Source Heroes of the High Court pg. 25
School divination; Level alchemist 1, arcanist 1, bard 1, cleric 1, inquisitor 1, investigator 1, oracle 1, psychic 1, skald 1, sorcerer 1, warpriest 1, witch 1, wizard 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (an eagle's eye)
Effect
Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Description
The target gains a +5 insight bonus on Perception checks to see through disguises. This bonus increases to +10 at caster level 7th.
